Greenway EHI export hub page linking to Intergy and Prime Suite EHI export documentation. Provides context about EHI export requirements and supported products.

JavaScript file containing all 261 table names and descriptions. Primary machine-readable source for the table listing.
JavaScript for table search/filter functionality in the viewer.
CSS stylesheet for individual table definition pages.
CSS stylesheet for the table of contents page.

261 individual HTML table definition pages, one per database table. Each contains field definitions (name, data type, default, null option, comment), parent table relationships with join conditions, and child table relationships with cascade behavior. Tables span demographics, encounters, problems, medications, allergies, labs, immunizations, vitals, care plans, billing, claims, insurance, OB/GYN, cardiology, documents, imaging, referrals, orders, and more. Total: 4,529 fields, 1,052 relationships across all tables.
files.curl_command: for TABLE in $(grep -oP "new Table\('\K[^']*" DBDescriptions.js); do curl -sL "https://ehi.greenwayhealth.com/Intergy/EHI/Viewer/Contracts/${TABLE}.htm" -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0' -o "${TABLE}.htm"; done
